title: Transmission Service
summary: Maintenance blueprint for checking transmission fluid condition, interval history, leak evidence, and pan/filter needs before quoting service.
symptoms: Mileage or time interval due for transmission fluid service
Fluid dark, burnt-smelling, low, contaminated, or unknown history
Light shift quality complaints without confirmed internal failure
Transmission pan, cooler line, or axle seal seepage noticed during inspection
inspect_first: Service interval, fluid specification, fill procedure, and temperature-check method
Fluid level and condition where a dipstick or service plug allows inspection
Pan gasket, cooler lines, axle seals, case seams, and vent condition
Whether the vehicle uses drain-and-fill, pan/filter service, or sealed-service procedure
repair_overview: Confirm fluid specification, service method, and any scan-tool temperature requirement.
Inspect fluid condition and leak evidence before draining.
Drain and refill, or remove pan and replace filter/gasket where applicable.
Set fluid level using the correct temperature and fill procedure.
Road test, recheck for leaks, and document any shift or contamination concerns.
common_mistakes: Using universal fluid when the transmission requires a specific fluid type
Overfilling or underfilling because temperature procedure was skipped
Promising service will fix a mechanical shift fault
Missing pan, cooler line, or axle seal leaks before service
estimate_guidance: Identify drain-and-fill versus pan/filter service so labor and parts match the vehicle.
Flag sealed transmissions that require level-setting by temperature.
Recommend diagnosis before service when slipping, harsh engagement, codes, or debris are present.
Include fluid quantity and pan/filter parts only when the service method requires them.

specialty: Scan tool for fluid temperature when required
supplies: Pan gasket or filter where applicable

recommended_repairs.title: Transmission Leak Diagnosis
recommended_repairs.description: Use when fluid level is low or active seepage is found before service.

recommended_repairs.title: Transmission Diagnostic
recommended_repairs.description: Use before maintenance when slipping, codes, delayed engagement, or harsh shifting are present.

diagnostic_context.intro: Transmission service is maintenance when interval and fluid condition support it; shift faults still need diagnosis before promising results.
